purpose: Resolve Alterna Énergie raw154 identity/accounting lineage before further tariff work.

deterministicIdentityEvidence.currentCrosswalk: Current national inventory surfaces the same hub/site family under Sorégies Mobilités and Alterna labels with FRSRG identifiers; Alterna raw estate is therefore branding/energy-supply lineage over the Sorégies charging estate rather than an independent tariff authority.

firstPartyEvidence.finding: Groupe Sorégies report states Sorégies deployed/operates the public charging network in Vienne, while Alterna énergie supplies green energy.
Current Energies Vienne charging program directs users to Sorégies Mobilités for the public charging service.
Current Sorégies Mobilités first-party service owns the charging-network tariff/application surface.
Current Sorégies Mobilités public tariff grid applies to Sorégies charging stations by power/time class.

tariffPolicy: No Alterna retail-energy or Electra partner tariff is promoted. Any tariff for an exact FRSRG EVSE must come from the validated/current Sorégies Mobilités charging authority and exact station/power/time rules.
